string.text: Experimental replacement of the barrel with a lower diameter one, which allows its calibre to be changed at the cost of lots of money.

The 6.5x25 CBJ Armor Piercing Discarding Sabot is the cartridge variant with the highest performance regarding armor piercing capability and long range ballistics. It has a tungsten core projectile enclosed in a discarding plastic sabot.
 
%c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Highest pierced armour class: %c[ui_gray_1]IV
%c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Tissue damage rating: %c[ui_gray_1]low

The 6.5x25 CBJ High Energy Transfer has a full caliber solid brass projectile with a hollow base. The bullet is highly effective against targets with moderate levels of protection within a range of about 50m, after which lethality is rapidly reduced.
 
%c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Highest pierced armour class: %c[ui_gray_1]IIIA
%c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Tissue damage rating: %c[ui_gray_1]medium - high

The 6.5x25 CBJ HP has a full caliber monolithic copper projectile with a hollow point. Within the lethal range of around 80m it is very effective against non protected targets, but beyond this range it quickly looses velocity and energy.
 
%c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Highest pierced armour class: %c[ui_gray_1]I
%c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Tissue damage rating: %c[ui_gray_1]high
